title: Shipped: singleton heartbeat → keyed multi-loop registry
summary: Converted the orchestrator daemon's singleton heartbeat loop into a keyed registry of loops driven by ONE heartbeat. Root problem: loop_start unconditionally overwrote a single global `loop` object (clobber on second start) and loops had no liveness tie to their session (zombie loops stayed active=true forever — e.g. dead session 0b0c92cd, 5 iters/32h). Shipped to main @509a15a (squash 4ae4e79), deployed live, verified. The 32h zombie was auto-demoted on first post-deploy heartbeat (sweptReason 'driving session dead'). This unblocks running concurrent loops — e.g. the RAG-fit experiment as its own loop alongside the existing improvement loop.
